# [TASK] Verify acceptance criteria on closed issues and cut Notes bloat

## Task
Go through every closed issue carrying unchecked acceptance criteria, verify each one against real code, and either check it with evidence, rescope it, or reopen the issue. Then cut the Notes sections that had become session transcripts.

## Scope
Issue content only, no repository changes. The template and contract fixes that stop this recurring are #248.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No closed issue carries an unchecked acceptance-criteria box, except where the remaining box explicitly depends on a human action
- [x] Every box checked here names the file, commit or test that proves it
- [x] Work that was delivered and later removed by a decision is rescoped in one line naming the ADR, not silently ticked
- [x] Any issue closed with no evidence the work exists is reopened with that evidence recorded
- [x] No issue body contains pasted build or test output

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes

24 closed issues carried unchecked criteria. 20 verified against real code and ticked with a one-line evidence pointer each (71 boxes including the Definition of Done on #77 and #96). #96's body still claimed Kafka had not started; it is fully implemented, so the text was corrected.

#138 and #145 were delivered (`bfc11e5`, `5615fc0`) and later removed by ADR-015 (`469e304`) — rescoped in one line rather than silently ticked. #120 had no workflow file and no commit referencing it at all, so it was reopened with that evidence.

Notes across 30 issues cut from 8,684 words to 2,712. #83's Notes contained an entire pasted Gradle build log; no pasted build output remains anywhere on the board.

Still unchecked by design: #177, whose last box waits on a human merging PRs.
